answered.sql: SELECT technique_id FROM Photography_Workshops_Techniques WHERE photography_workshop_id IN (SELECT workshop_id FROM Photography_Workshops) GROUP BY technique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT photography_workshop_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Photography_Workshops)

candidates.meaning: Find the techniques for each photography workshop.
candidates.sql: SELECT pwt.technique_id, pw.workshop_id, t.technique_name FROM Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt JOIN Photography_Workshops pw ON pwt.photography_workshop_id = pw.workshop_id JOIN Techniques t ON pwt.technique_id = t.technique_id

candidates.meaning: List the techniques for each photography workshop.

candidates.meaning: List the techniques for each workshop session, considering the workshop leader.
candidates.sql: SELECT ws.session_id, t.technique_name FROM Workshop_Sessions ws JOIN Photography_Workshops pw ON ws.workshop_title = pw.workshop_title JOIN Photography_Workshops_Techniques pwt ON pw.workshop_id = pwt.photography_workshop_id JOIN Techniques t ON pwt.technique_id = t.technique_id
